summary: Added a compiled-children-specific closed request/cancel host driver around the shared compiled mount; Go retains collection identity and lifetime state while the host records effect correlations and manual replies.

api.mount: mountCompiledChildrenApp({module, componentId?, appId?, encoder, renderer, onTick?, onFailure?}) -> {runtime, effects}

checks.result: Expected red before implementation: 5 tests failed because mountCompiledChildrenApp and the host exports were not yet present.

A temporary replay of the first post-implementation test assumptions reproduced two test-only failures: the shared completion return has no completedEffects array, and a renderer declaring view.node is compatible. The replay source was removed after capturing the log; final assertions inspect the host completion record and reject a renderer with no view capabilities.
Passed: 42 tests, 42 passed, 0 failed (6 host tests and 36 shared-runtime tests).

checks.command:
set -o pipefail
(
  /tmp/gondola-node22/node_modules/node/bin/node --check compiled-children/runtime/runtime.mjs &&
  /tmp/gondola-node22/node_modules/node/bin/node --check compiled-children/runtime/runtime.test.mjs &&
  git diff --check -- compiled-children/runtime
) 2>&1 | tee compiled-children/coordination/rawlogs/E-HOST-green-static.log
checks.result: Passed both Node syntax checks and git diff --check for the owned runtime directory.

limitations: The focused host suite uses a synthetic compiled-ABI module to isolate host behavior; actual Go fixture parity is owned by the N4 harness and root full-run.
The shared compiled frontend runtime and existing compiled-lifecycle wrapper were not modified.
The whole native allocation/receipt protocol and React/DOM/native integration remain root acceptance gates.
integration: pending N4 actual Go replay, N6 delivery runner, and root read-only native protocol audit
publication: No Git commit, merge, or deployment.
